summary: Fremont NF site: an L-5 cab built in 1934 at Coleman Point, moved here in 1948 (1949 per one register); gone by 1967, or burned by 1968.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1967 per the register and firelookout.com. A 1968 Forest Service letter says it was burned.

events.note: CCC camp at Dog Lake listed a 1934 project to build a lookout at Fitzwater Point
The L-5 cab built in 1934 at Coleman Point was moved here and rebuilt on a rock foundation. The Fitzwater register gives 1949.
Air marking number for the station: F-21
James Jacobsgaard named as a first-season lookout (Herald and News)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Coleman Point register page, firelookout.com and the Oregon list give 1948 for the move here; the Fitzwater register page gives 1949. The story uses 1948 and mentions the register's 1949.
The register and firelookout.com say the cab was gone by 1967. The Oregon list quotes a May 1968 Forest Service letter saying it was burned. The story reports both without choosing.

sources.title: Fitzwater Point

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains at the site or whether it is open to visitors, so access and visit are left out. Coleman Point has its own register record; the editor may want to check that its build and move dates match this story. The brief's elevation (1952.9 m) agrees with the register's 1,953 m. The 1960 staffing item is from a Herald and News quote on the Oregon list and is not confirmed elsewhere.
